# Module `crypto`

Web Crypto: random values, UUIDs and digests (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 through BCrypt; large inputs are
hashed on a worker thread).

Exposed to: Window. Source: `api/crypto.widl`.
